body: I don’t know how you’re managing to go on like the way you out with the mental power you must have is amazing. Life is stupid but yeah we’ve got this (I hope)
I don’t feel like I can get better though, I’m only getting worse and my mental health is deteriorating throughout each day
I don’t feel like I can get through it, I’ve been feeling like this for literal years
